assets.name: survivor
assets.prompt: Original production game sprite sheet for EMBERWATCH, a warm muted post-apocalyptic pixel-art survival card battler. Cohesive palette: dusty ochre, rust orange, charcoal mauve, desaturated teal, warm beige highlights. Crisp deliberately visible pixel clusters, dark 1-pixel outlines, clear shaped anatomy, detailed clothing shading, authentic polished 16-bit indie game sprites. Not a vector icon, not a blocky stick figure. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Canvas very wide 3:1, divided into EXACTLY THREE equally wide invisible cells in a single horizontal row. Each cell contains the SAME full-body character at the SAME scale with feet at exactly the same baseline at 90% of canvas height and generous transparent padding on all sides. Character fills about 78% of cell height. No overlapping cells, no labels, no text, no borders. Cell 1 idle combat stance; cell 2 active attack pose; cell 3 recoiling hurt pose. Three animation poses, NOT three different characters. Subject: a resourceful adult survivor facing RIGHT in all cells, dark cropped hair, faded mustard weatherproof jacket over dark teal clothes, leather satchel and bandaged forearm, sturdy boots. A rusty kitchen cleaver held in the right hand. Idle ready stance with bent knees; attacking is a forward cleaver slash with the blade extended RIGHT; hurt is a backward recoil. A grounded believable human survivor, no helmet and no guns.
assets.notes: A second built-in edit removed background haze while preserving all poses.

assets.name: card-art
assets.prompt: Original game card illustration atlas, perfectly regular 3 columns by 2 rows, SIX equally sized square cells, no gutter, no borders, no labels, no lettering, no UI. Cohesive polished 16-bit pixel art, visible pixel clusters, deep charcoal mauve backgrounds, dusty ochre, warm beige and rust orange, restrained teal highlights, consistent dramatic rim lighting. Each cell is a detailed symbolic ACTION illustration designed for a post-apocalyptic card battler, with clear readable silhouette. Top left: bandaged survivor fist striking a battered infected silhouette, dynamic diagonal. Top middle: survivor in mustard coat ducking behind a rough scrap-metal shield, incoming sparks. Top right: close-up rusty kitchen cleaver with wrapped handle on a worn utility belt, warm edge light. Bottom left: reinforced teal riot shield deflecting a fierce orange impact, strong defensive shape. Bottom middle: hands carefully repairing a cracked armored vest with wire and a medical patch, soft green glow. Bottom right: a heavy improvised sledgehammer crashing into rubble with angular orange impact rays. Original art, consistent craft across all 6 tiles, no realistic painting and no vector icons, strictly chunky pixel art, full bleed illustrations filling each cell. Landscape canvas 3:2.

assets.name: battle-street
assets.prompt: Original production background for a 2D side-on post-apocalyptic card battle, 16:9 wide composition. Polished authentic 16-bit pixel art with crisp visible pixel clusters and restrained dithering. Warm muted dusk palette: dusty salmon, ochre, charcoal mauve shadows, rust orange, very subtle desaturated teal. A ruined urban street in front of abandoned brick workshops, broken concrete arches and dusty distant rooftops, faded sunlight cutting through haze. A broad, flat stone-and-asphalt combat stage occupies the lower third. Two clear open fighting spaces at 25% and 75% of image width, no obstructing props in those spaces. Layers of parallax depth: distant skyline, middle abandoned workshops, foreground rubble only at extreme lower corners. Beautiful atmospheric environmental detail, unified with a gritty survivor game, no characters, no cards, no interface, no text, no logos, no watermark. Not a screenshot; clean background asset.

assets.name: survivor-unarmed
assets.source: Built-in image_gen edit of the original survivor sheet
assets.prompt: Create the UNARMED version of this exact game sprite sheet. Keep the three character poses, face, clothes, satchel, palette, pixel edges, scale, cell locations, empty transparent space and canvas dimensions unchanged. Remove the cleaver from all three poses. Replace it with the survivor natural bandaged empty hand: first idle pose a relaxed clenched fist, second attack pose a forward clenched-fist punch to the RIGHT, third hurt pose a recoiling empty hand. No other weapons or props added. Preserve true alpha transparency: outside character silhouettes alpha must be exactly zero, no background, halo, shadows, haze, labels, borders or checkerboard.
